name: Ollie Owner Approval Router
description: HARD pre-LLM owner approval router for Hands consent and WhatsApp contact gating. Owner approve/deny interception stays active whenever the plugin is loaded; enabled only toggles WhatsApp contact gating. Contact (W-) decisions are Telegram-only in both directions; Hands (H-) decisions are also accepted from the owner's WhatsApp.

enabled.description: Controls WhatsApp contact gating only. When false, inbound/outbound WhatsApp contact gating and outbound cancellation are inert. Owner Telegram/WhatsApp text approve/deny interception and Telegram inline approval callbacks remain active whenever the plugin is loaded.

ownerTelegramChatId.description: Telegram chat id of the owner. Approval requests are sent here; replies are correlated from here.

ownerWhatsAppNumber.description: Owner E.164 WhatsApp number whose approve/deny replies are intercepted before the LLM. Hands (H-) refs only: WhatsApp contact gating (W-) can never be decided from WhatsApp.

approvalsFile.description: Path to the JSON state file with {owner, approved[], blocked[], pending{}}. Tilde is expanded at runtime.

requestTimeoutMinutes.description: How long a pending approval request lives before it is auto-expired (for visibility only — expired requests are pruned; a later message from that number creates a fresh ref).

hookTimeoutMs.description: Per-hook budget for the Telegram push + state write. Default 5000ms (override the OpenClaw default of 15000ms for before_agent_run).

handsApprovalToken.description: Approval-only Hands credential from approval.token. Never use the MCP bearer token here.

enabled.label: Gate enabled
enabled.help: Controls WhatsApp contact gating only. When false, inbound/outbound WhatsApp contact gating and outbound cancellation are inert. Owner text approve/deny interception and Telegram callback routing remain active whenever the plugin is loaded.

ownerTelegramChatId.label: Owner Telegram chat id
ownerTelegramChatId.help: The chat id that receives approval requests and whose replies correlate. Defaults to the live Ollie owner's id (<OWNER_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID>).

ownerWhatsAppNumber.label: Owner WhatsApp number
ownerWhatsAppNumber.help: E.164 number authorized to approve or deny Hands (H-) actions from WhatsApp, because the owner's own message opens the 24h window. WhatsApp contact approvals (W-) are refused here and must be answered on Telegram. All other WhatsApp senders remain subject to the contact gate.

approvalsFile.label: State file
approvalsFile.help: JSON file holding approved[]/blocked[]/pending{}. Default reuses the existing whatsapp-contacts.json created by the openclaw installer (compatible format).

requestTimeoutMinutes.label: Pending request timeout (minutes)
requestTimeoutMinutes.help: Cosmetic. Pending requests older than this are pruned from the state file; a later message creates a fresh ref. No auto-approve.

hookTimeoutMs.label: Hook timeout (ms)
hookTimeoutMs.help: Per-hook budget. Telegram sends should be < 2s in practice; 5s is a generous ceiling.
